description:
Alert history for an agent: budget warnings (80% threshold) and spending spikes.

Requires a credential: either the agent's own agent_secret or its
workspace's workspace_key (same rule as GET /v1/alerts).

agent_secret.description: the agent's own secret (either this or workspace_key)

workspace_key.description: the owning workspace's key (either this or agent_secret)

name: ledger_alerts
title: Agent Budget Alerts
